name: @postwave/offline-outbox
description: The shared, non-drifting core of the offline-mutation outbox — the reconciled replay-status union, the attempt budget, the byte-identical terminal-state predicate, and the common OfflineMutation field set that web + desktop both extend. The storage engine + replay loop stay per-surface (they legitimately differ); this is the contract they cannot afford to drift on.
author: Moosewave
